newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products were mixed, some gain, others los.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products were mixed, some gain, others los.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Thursday.
Gas oil shed $1.50 on futures. Premiums were pressured by ample supply. Naphtha held an easy tone.
Gasoline was firmer on good buying interest for fob parcels for arbitrage out of the region. Eurograde barges traded up to $225 for prompt lifting with early Jan liftings done at $222.50.
Fuel oil was firmer on barges, but weaker on cargoes. Interest in high sulphur cargoes was very limited. Low sulphur activity was busier with two cargoes sold, one at $124 fob NWE.
